subject: Biology
title: Animal Kingdom
summary: Animals ko basic features par classify karte hain: level of organisation, symmetry, germ layers (diploblastic ya triploblastic), coelom, segmentation aur notochord.

Non-chordate phyla Porifera (cellular level) aur Cnidaria (tissue level, radial, diploblastic) se shuru hoke Ctenophora, flatworms (Platyhelminthes), roundworms (Aschelminthes) aur Annelida se Arthropoda (sabse bada phylum), Mollusca, Echinodermata aur Hemichordata tak jaate hain.
Chordate mein kisi na kisi stage par notochord, dorsal hollow nerve cord aur pharyngeal gill slits hote hain. Vertebrates mein notochord ki jagah vertebral column aa jaata hai.
Vertebrate ki har class — Cyclostomata, Chondrichthyes, Osteichthyes, Amphibia, Reptilia, Aves aur Mammalia — skin, heart, respiration, temperature regulation aur reproduction mein alag hai.

formulas.name: Levels of organisation
formulas.formula: cellular (Porifera) → tissue (Cnidaria, Ctenophora) → organ (Platyhelminthes) → organ system (Aschelminthes onwards)

formulas.name: Symmetry
formulas.formula: asymmetrical (most sponges);  radial (Cnidaria, Ctenophora, adult Echinodermata);  bilateral (Platyhelminthes onwards)
formulas.mistake: Echinoderm ke larvae bilateral hote hain; adults radial — dono ko ek mat samjho.

formulas.name: Germ layers
formulas.formula: diploblastic: ectoderm + endoderm with mesoglea (Cnidaria, Ctenophora);  triploblastic: + mesoderm (Platyhelminthes to Chordata)

formulas.name: Coelom
formulas.formula: acoelomate: Platyhelminthes;  pseudocoelomate: Aschelminthes;  coelomate: Annelida, Arthropoda, Mollusca, Echinodermata, Hemichordata, Chordata

formulas.name: Porifera
formulas.formula: canal system (ostia → spongocoel → osculum), choanocytes (collar cells), spicules/spongin fibres; hermaphrodite; internal fertilisation; indirect development

formulas.name: Cnidaria and Ctenophora
formulas.formula: Cnidaria: cnidoblasts (stinging cells), polyp and medusa forms, metagenesis (Obelia) — Hydra, Physalia, Adamsia, Pennatula, Meandrina;  Ctenophora: comb plates, bioluminescence — Pleurobrachia, Ctenoplana

formulas.name: Worms
formulas.formula: Platyhelminthes: flattened, flame cells, hooks/suckers (Taenia, Fasciola, Planaria regenerates);  Aschelminthes: round, separate sexes, female larger (Ascaris, Wuchereria, Ancylostoma);  Annelida: metameric segmentation, nephridia, closed circulation (Nereis, Pheretima, Hirudinaria)

formulas.name: Arthropoda
formulas.formula: jointed appendages, chitinous exoskeleton, open circulation; respiration by gills, book gills, book lungs or tracheae; Malpighian tubules; compound eyes, statocysts
formulas.when: Sabse bada phylum (animal species ka do-tihaai se zyada).

formulas.name: Mollusca and Echinodermata
formulas.formula: Mollusca: soft body, mantle, calcareous shell, radula, ctenidia (Pila, Pinctada, Sepia, Loligo, Octopus);  Echinodermata: spiny calcareous ossicles, water vascular system (tube feet), all marine (Asterias, Echinus, Antedon, Cucumaria, Ophiura)
formulas.mistake: Sepia (cuttlefish), Loligo (squid) aur Octopus (devil fish) molluscs hain, fish nahi.

formulas.name: Chordate features
formulas.formula: notochord + dorsal hollow nerve cord + paired pharyngeal gill slits + post-anal tail

formulas.name: Chordate subphyla
formulas.formula: Urochordata: notochord only in larval tail (Ascidia, Salpa, Doliolum);  Cephalochordata: notochord from head to tail throughout life (Branchiostoma/Amphioxus);  Vertebrata: vertebral column

formulas.name: Heart chambers
formulas.formula: fish 2;  amphibians and reptiles 3 (crocodile 4);  birds and mammals 4

formulas.name: Vertebrate classes
formulas.formula: Cyclostomata (jawless, suctorial mouth — Petromyzon, Myxine);  Chondrichthyes (cartilage, placoid scales, no air bladder — Scoliodon, Pristis, Trygon, Torpedo);  Osteichthyes (bone, operculum, air bladder — Labeo, Catla, Hippocampus, Exocoetus);  Amphibia (moist skin, cloaca — Rana, Bufo, Salamandra, Ichthyophis);  Reptilia (dry scaly skin — Chelone, Chameleon, Naja, Vipera);  Aves (feathers, pneumatic bones — Corvus, Columba, Struthio, Pavo);  Mammalia (hair, mammary glands, external ears — Ornithorhynchus oviparous, Macropus, Pteropus, Balaenoptera)

formulas.name: Cold vs warm blooded
formulas.formula: poikilothermous: fish, amphibians, reptiles;  homoiothermous: birds and mammals

examples.title: Metagenesis
examples.solution: Kuch cnidarians mein polyp (asexual) aur medusa (sexual) generations ka baari-baari aana — Obelia: polyps asexually medusae banate hain; medusae sexually polyps banate hain.

examples.title: Pseudocoelom
examples.problem: Kis phylum mein pseudocoelom hai, aur iska matlab kya?
examples.solution: Aschelminthes (roundworms). Body cavity poori tarah mesoderm se lined nahi hoti; mesoderm ectoderm aur endoderm ke beech bikhre pouches ki tarah hota hai.

examples.title: Fish nahi hai
examples.problem: Inme se asli fish kaun hai: jellyfish, starfish, cuttlefish, flying fish, silverfish?
examples.solution: Sirf flying fish (Exocoetus, Osteichthyes). Jellyfish — Cnidaria; starfish — Echinodermata; cuttlefish — Mollusca; silverfish — insect (Arthropoda).

examples.title: Ande dene wala mammal
examples.problem: Ek oviparous mammal ka naam batao.

examples.title: Electric organ aur poison sting
examples.problem: Kaunsi cartilaginous fish mein electric organ hai aur kisme poison sting?
examples.solution: Torpedo mein electric organs; Trygon (sting ray) mein poison sting.

examples.title: Excretory structures
examples.problem: Match karo: flame cells, nephridia, Malpighian tubules, green glands.
examples.solution: Flame cells — Platyhelminthes; nephridia — Annelida; Malpighian tubules — zyadatar insects (Arthropoda); green glands — prawn jaise crustaceans.

topics.title: Segmentation
topics.explain: Metameric segmentation — body bahar aur andar se repeated segments mein bati hoti hai aur kuch organs serially repeat hote hain — Annelida (earthworm), Arthropoda aur Chordata mein.

topics.title: Hemichordata
topics.explain: Worm jaise marine animals jinmein proboscis, collar aur trunk hote hain; pehle Chordata mein rakhe gaye the par inmein stomochord hai (asli notochord nahi), isliye ab alag non-chordate phylum: Balanoglossus, Saccoglossus.

topics.title: Arthropod examples
topics.explain: Economically important: Apis (honey bee), Bombyx (silkworm), Laccifer (lac insect). Vectors: Anopheles, Culex, Aedes (mosquitoes). Jhund mein rehne wala pest: Locusta. Aur: Limulus, butterfly, scorpion, prawn.

topics.title: Amphibians and reptiles
topics.explain: Amphibians: do jode limbs, bina scales ki geeli skin, eyelids wali aankhein, tympanum, cloaca, external fertilisation, gills, lungs aur skin se respiration. Reptiles: sookhi cornified skin scales ya scutes ke saath, external ear opening nahi, internal fertilisation, shell wale ande; snakes aur lizards skin ko cast ki tarah utaarte hain.

topics.title: Birds
topics.explain: Feathers, beak, forelimbs wings mein badle, hind limbs par scales, pneumatic (hawa bhari) bones, crop aur gizzard, lungs se jude air sacs, four-chambered heart, oviparous aur direct development. Flightless birds: Struthio (ostrich), Aptenodytes (penguin).

topics.title: Mammals
topics.explain: Mammary glands, hair, external pinnae, alag-alag type ke daant, four-chambered heart, zyadatar viviparous. Pteropus (flying fox) udta hai; Balaenoptera (blue whale), Delphinus (dolphin) paani mein rehte hain; Macropus (kangaroo) marsupial hai.

ratta: Coelom: acoelomate flatworms, pseudocoelomate roundworms, rest coelomate.
Arthropoda largest phylum;  Limulus = living fossil.
Notochord: larval tail (Uro), head to tail (Cephalo).
Platypus lays eggs;  Torpedo electric;  Trygon sting.
